hero.heading: We build and back companies for the [long view].
hero.lede: DF Group partners with founders, corporates, and investors across Asia and beyond — pairing a global advisory network with patient capital and hands-on execution.

intro.statement: Diligent in our research. [Faithful] to the companies we back.
paragraphs: DF Group is a Hong Kong–based corporate advisory and investment house. We work at the intersection of strategy and capital — advising boards, structuring transactions, and investing alongside founders we believe in.

Our strength is our people: a multidisciplinary network of more than one hundred advisors spanning finance, technology, industry, and operations across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. We bring that collective judgement to every mandate, and we stay for the long term.

practices.heading: Six practices, one partnership
practices.lede: From first strategy to exit, we operate across the full lifecycle of a business — as advisor, builder, and investor.

items.title: Corporate & Investment Strategy
items.desc: Board-level advice on growth, capital allocation, and market entry — grounded in original research and cross-border perspective.

items.title: Venture Building
items.desc: We co-found and scale new ventures, supplying operating talent, structure, and capital from the earliest stage.

items.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
items.desc: Buy-side and sell-side execution — sourcing, valuation, diligence, and negotiation through to completion.

items.title: Investor Relations
items.desc: Positioning companies with the right capital partners, and managing the relationship long after the deal closes.

items.title: Executive Training & Networking
items.desc: Programmes and convenings that connect leaders across our network and sharpen how they lead.

items.title: Event & Media Management
items.desc: End-to-end production of the events, panels, and media that build a company’s profile and relationships.

approach.statement: We create value with our network, our expertise, and [capital that waits].
paragraphs: Good companies are rarely built in a single quarter. We take the time to understand a business, price it on fundamentals rather than narrative, and support it through the parts of the journey that don’t make headlines.
That patience is only possible because of who sits around the table — operators, researchers, and specialists who have built and run companies themselves. When we commit, we commit as partners.

affiliations.heading: The company we keep
affiliations.lede: DF Group partners with, sponsors, and takes part in leading institutions and communities across Asia and Europe.

cta.heading: Let’s start a conversation.
cta.text: Whether you’re raising capital, exploring a transaction, or want to join the network, we’d like to hear from you.
